# CSR Geometry Architecture

The core of Subsetix Kokkos is the **Compressed Sparse Row (CSR) of Intervals** data structure for sparse 2D domains.

## Data Structure

```cpp
template <class MemorySpace>
struct IntervalSet2D {
  Kokkos::View<RowKey2D*, MemorySpace> row_keys;     // Y coordinates per row
  Kokkos::View<std::size_t*, MemorySpace> row_ptr;    // CSR row pointers
  Kokkos::View<Interval*, MemorySpace> intervals;     // [begin, end) X intervals
  Kokkos::View<std::size_t*, MemorySpace> cell_offsets; // Cell offset per interval
  std::size_t total_cells;   // Sum of all interval lengths
};
```

## Key Features

- **Memory-efficient** - Only stores active cells in the domain
- **GPU-compatible** - Uses Kokkos::View for device memory
- **Fast set operations** - Union, intersection, difference via parallel kernels

## Location

- Header: `include/subsetix/geometry/interval_set_2d.hpp`
- Kernels: `include/subsetix/csr_ops/set_algebra.hpp`
